posts.title: Exploring the CLC Color Space in 3D
posts.description: The CLC (Chroma–Luma Cone) Color Space is a geometric, RGB-derived model designed to make color visualization more intuitive. Unlike traditional 2D representations like HSV or HSL, CLC maps colors into a 3D double-cone structure, allowing you to explore relationships between hue, chroma, and brightness in a visually meaningful way.
